description: Read/write: through LK run an UPDATE that matches three rows by a duplicated non-key value, an INSERT with every field, an INSERT without the counter key, a DELETE, a 5,000-character memo UPDATE, and an AddNew/Update and Edit/Update on a dynaset (reading LastModified bookmark and fields); RecordsAffected after each. An independent Workspace then reads the source copy directly.
retentionNote: Designed r-enc-link probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
